Running Python code interactively: # UDP payload (MLE message):
mle_payload = payload[10:]
print(f"MLE payload: {mle_payload.hex()}")
print(f"MLE payload length: {len(mle_payload)}")
print()

# MLE Header:
# mSecuritySuite: 1 byte
# mSecurityControl: 1 byte
# mFrameCounter: 4 bytes
# mKeySource: 4 bytes
# mKeyIndex: 1 byte
# mCommand: 1 byte

sec_suite = mle_payload[0]
print(f"Security Suite: 0x{sec_suite:02x}")

if sec_suite == 0:  # k154Security
    sec_control = mle_payload[1]
    frame_counter = int.from_bytes(mle_payload[2:6], 'little')
    key_source = int.from_bytes(mle_payload[6:10], 'big')
    key_index = mle_payload[10]
    command = mle_payload[11]
    print(f"Security Control: 0x{sec_control:02x}")
    print(f"Frame Counter: {frame_counter}")
    print(f"Key Source: 0x{key_source:08x}")
    print(f"Key Index: {key_index}")
    print(f"Command: {command}")
    
    # MLE header length = 12 bytes
    mle_tlvs = mle_payload[12:]
    print(f"\nMLE TLVs: {mle_tlvs.hex()}")
    print(f"MLE TLVs length: {len(mle_tlvs)}")
    
    # Parse TLVs
    off = 0
    while off < len(mle_tlvs):
        tlv_type = mle_tlvs[off]
        tlv_len = mle_tlvs[off+1]
        tlv_val = mle_tlvs[off+2:off+2+tlv_len]
        print(f"  TLV type={tlv_type}, len={tlv_len}, val={tlv_val.hex()}")
        off += 2 + tlv_len
